name: Mount Wuyi
description: Mount Wuyi, in northern Fujian province, is a range of steep cliffs and misty peaks, with the winding Nine Bend River cutting gorges through it. Its forests shelter many ancient, rare species found only in China. Neo-Confucian thought took shape among its temples and monasteries, and the hills still produce famed teas like Da Hong Pao and lapsang souchong.
